scope: P18.4 candidate triage after compact weighted CRS adoption; no candidate changed the protocol or artifact format.

environment.input: local normalized QAP library and 172-placement synthesizer fixture

decisions.reason: Even eliminating all nonpublic scalar-label work would improve the full trusted setup by at most 1.95%; the candidate would add a second image-accumulation path without affecting dominant fixed-base encoding.

decisions.candidate: parse only real witness ranges at native ingress
decisions.reason: The entire fixture ingress is 80.97 ms (2.27% of the measured proof), and parsing is only part of that span. The current direct m-wide indexing is simpler and preserves one witness representation.
Only denominator construction, inversion, and recurrence are removable; together they are 10.77 ms (0.30% of proof time). The 132.12 ms polynomial-product quotient remains dense.

127 of 1295 retained rows are all zero for this execution. Existing CPU MSM filtering already removes zero scalar/base pairs. At most 3.88 ms of the 39.58 ms selection interpolation span could disappear, below the adoption threshold.
The complete arithmetic and connection domains remain protocol inputs, and no existing provider primitive offers an equivalent faster sparse transform.
